title: Silver Rewards Card: New Customer Promo - $500 Statement Credit Signup Bonus
summary: This document describes the Silver Rewards Card $500 statement credit signup bonus: open a new account between 2025-01-01 and 2025-06-30 and spend $2,000 in net purchases within 1 month of account opening to earn a $500 credit. The credit typically posts within two billing cycles after meeting the requirement, and you must keep the account open and in good standing through bonus fulfillment.
